title: {{NAME}} and the Goal That Took a Whole Team
moral: When you pass to your friends, everyone gets to win together.

pages.content: {{NAME}} ran onto the bright green soccer field. The crowd was cheering loudly. The sky was blue and the sun was warm. Big white goal posts stood at each end. Today was the big match. {{NAME}} wanted to score every goal himself.

pages.content: {{NAME}} ran and ran with the ball. But the other team was fast. They blocked him every time. His friend Mia was open and waving. But {{NAME}} did not pass. He tried again alone. He missed again.

pages.content: After the game, {{NAME}} lay in the soft grass. He looked up at the big sky. The stars were starting to come out. When you share with your friends, everyone feels happy. {{NAME}} smiled his biggest smile. He yawned and closed his eyes. And somewhere on the dark field, the soccer ball rolled slowly all by itself.
